gate_title: GEN0002 Pass2 scientific accession adjudication authority

proposed_authority_delta.proposal: AUTHORISE_ONLY_THE_GEN0002_PASS2_SURVIVAL_ROLE_DESTINATION_EFFECT_ADJUDICATION_REQUIRED_BY_THE_RATIFIED_LSIAC_SEQUENCE, USING_THE_EFFECTIVE_FROZEN_PASS1_VIEW_AND_UNCHANGED_FROZEN_PROTOCOL, INCLUDING_FINAL_LSIAC_INHERITANCE_AND_LIFECYCLE RECORDS AND REQUIRED_HIGH_IMPACT_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, WITHOUT DOWNSTREAM ACTIVATION OR SCIENCE_RESUME.

acceptance_conditions: Operator explicitly grants the bounded Pass2 adjudication delta and no broader science-resume authority.
Pass2 consumes only the effective GEN0002 Pass1 classification view and unchanged GEN0002-bound frozen protocol semantics.
Every Pass2 subject is accounted for against the 431-subject frontier; source-blocked or not-evaluable subjects fail closed.
The total claim-strength cap, role-admissibility matrix, scope intersection rule, dependence graph and counterevidence completeness are applied before any positive survival or role decision.
RETAIN_FORWARD requires at least one independently admissible non-NONE role; source-blocked subjects cannot receive non-NONE final roles.
CANONICAL_PRINCIPLE, CANONICAL_CAPABILITY, CROSS_ARCHITECTURE_AMENDMENT_REQUIRED and SOURCE_CONFLICT_RESOLUTION cannot close or retain forward without complete hashed independent review evidence.
Destination and architecture-effect outputs remain declarative LSIAC adjudication records and do not themselves change any owner, ontology, selector, model, Validation state or publication authority.
Targeted tests, repository-wide assurance, QA, exact-head VIT/SIQ and merge readiness must pass before any Pass2 integration.
Any need to materially change the frozen protocol, frontier or Pass1 view stops execution and returns to an operator gate.
warnings: The Pass1 programme-state artifact merged with conditional pre-integration fields, but its stated effect rule is satisfied by the exact qualified tree and squash integration at 2688caed89ce5db10c06a40806dba1e251786600; this gate state records the effective post-merge condition without rewriting Pass1 history.
Two known source-binding debts remain and must remain not-evaluable/source-blocked wherever exact load-bearing evidence is required.
No absence of a dependence edge may be interpreted as independence.
A PASS here is not LSIAC-SCIENCE-RESUME and cannot activate downstream scientific development.
rollback: Forward-only. If the decision is DEFER, BLOCK, QUARANTINE or otherwise not PASS, preserve the effective Pass1 freeze and all prior evidence, leave scientific accession decisions at zero, leave Pass2 unstarted and keep the Section-23 development freeze active. No protocol/source rewrite, history rewrite or downstream activation is permitted.
exact_work_after_approval: Create a fresh bounded Pass2 packet branch from the latest lawful main tip; do not continue from the Pass1 feature branch or this gate branch.
Bind the effective GEN0002 Pass1 virtual view, 431-subject/434-passport frontier, source-dependence graph and unchanged GEN0002 protocol binding as immutable inputs.

Implement deterministic Pass2 admissibility and claim-cap mechanics plus machine schemas/fixtures/tests needed to produce survival, inheritance-role, lifecycle, destination and architecture-effect adjudication records.
Generate complete subject accounting and fail closed on source-blocked, not-evaluable, unresolved-conflict and unsupported positive claims.
Materialise and hash independent review packets for every high-impact trigger before any triggered decision can close or receive RETAIN_FORWARD.
Generate QA, decision/gate evidence and programme state; run targeted and repository-wide tests, exact-head VIT qualification, FINAL_HEAD assurance, SIQ and merge readiness.

Integrate only the bounded Pass2 adjudication packet if all acceptance conditions and required reviews pass within the operator-granted delta; do not execute downstream architecture/owner changes or science resume.

Continue to the ratified post-Pass2 register materialisation and architecture-reconciliation sequence until the next genuine operator-reserved boundary, with LSIAC-SCIENCE-RESUME remaining separately reserved.
